get.description: Get project check status and per-check failure rates among evaluated traces. Health checks use time-based sampling; counts and rates do not cover all ingested traces, and healthy with zero evaluations is not proof of coverage. Read sampling_interval_seconds for the configured cooldown. Get results for an explicit time range of at most 31 days. Choose category trace_health (default) for instrumentation health or conversation_view for Conversation View compatibility.

schema.description: Choose instrumentation health or Conversation View compatibility checks
Inclusive ISO 8601 start timestamp
Exclusive ISO 8601 end timestamp

sampling_interval_seconds.description: Minimum cooldown between newly selected traces per project. Selected traces can be rechecked; reconciliation can also evaluate never-finalized traces.

status.description: Health among evaluated traces, excluding muted checks. Healthy does not prove all ingested traces were evaluated, including when evaluated counts are zero.

is_muted.description: Muted checks do not affect project health

evaluated_trace_count.description: Evaluated traces, not total ingested traces.

applicable_trace_count.description: Evaluated traces to which this check applies.

affected_trace_count.description: Known failing evaluated traces, not an exhaustive count across all ingested traces.

failure_rate.description: Failure rate among applicable evaluated traces, not a population estimate.

get.summary: Get trace health for one trace
get.description: Get stored check results for one trace; this does not trigger an evaluation. Missing or not_evaluated results are not passes or promises of a future evaluation: unsampled traces may remain unevaluated. Results include applicability, failures, example span IDs, remediation, and evaluation metadata. Choose category trace_health (default) for instrumentation health or conversation_view for Conversation View compatibility.

schema.description: The trace ID
Choose instrumentation health or Conversation View compatibility checks

is_muted.description: Muted checks retain raw diagnostic results

status.description: Null means no stored result; not_evaluated means the check could not run. Neither is a pass or a guarantee of later evaluation.
